_about: The models Hugging Force shows as stars. Picked by hand on 2026-10-23 to spread across Hugging Face's four main modalities (language, vision, audio, multimodal) and across time on the Hub: early classics, 2023-2025 favorites, and models among the most trending on the Hub that day. Everything else about a model (its numbers, task, license, model tree) comes from the Hub API when `npm run catalog` runs. Add or remove an id here, then run `npm run catalog`.
